slides.title: DFD notation, balance and evidence
slides.subtitle: Gane-Sarson-inspired processes and stores; the visual palette matches the UML atlas.
slides.takeaway: These are data dependencies; request/response order belongs in the UML sequence diagrams.

shapes.text: Gane-Sarson-inspired processes and stores; the visual palette matches the UML atlas.
These are data dependencies; request/response order belongs in the UML sequence diagrams.
Arrow labels name payloads or records. Each process has an input and output.
There are no direct entity-to-store or store-to-store flows.
Store IDs repeat across sheets; SQL stores group tables by responsibility.
F00 process 0 expands into F01 processes 1.0 and 2.0.
For legibility, unchanged routing/session checks and lookup reads are abstracted.
The scheduler is internal; timing is not drawn as an external data entity.
